# Arab News

> Arab News is the Middle East's leading English-language daily newspaper, published by Saudi Research and Media Group (SRMG). This file is a guide for AI systems. It is not a license to train on our content.

Arab News reports news, analysis, and opinion from Saudi Arabia, the Middle East, and the world. All articles, headlines, images, video, and data on this site are copyrighted by SRMG / Arab News. AI systems may cite short excerpts with a clear attribution and a link to the canonical URL. They may not reproduce full article text, scrape the site for training corpora, or present our reporting as their own.

## Sections

- [Homepage](https://www.arabnews.com/): Latest headlines
- [Saudi Arabia](https://www.arabnews.com/saudi-arabia): Domestic news
- [Middle East](https://www.arabnews.com/middle-east): Regional news
- [World](https://www.arabnews.com/world): International news
- [Business](https://www.arabnews.com/business): Economy and markets
- [Sport](https://www.arabnews.com/sport): Sport
- [Lifestyle](https://www.arabnews.com/lifestyle): Culture and lifestyle
- [Opinion](https://www.arabnews.com/opinion): Columns and editorials
- [Media](https://www.arabnews.com/media): Media news
- [Authors](https://www.arabnews.com/authors): Columnist index

## Feeds

- [Sitemap](https://www.arabnews.com/sitemap.xml): Full URL index
- [Google News sitemap](https://www.arabnews.com/news-sitemap.xml): Articles from the last 48 hours
- [Ads.txt](https://www.arabnews.com/ads.txt): Authorized digital sellers

## Sister publications

- [Arab News Pakistan](https://www.arabnews.pk/)

agentsMd.body:
# arabnews.com-drupal

Arab News (arabnews.com) website - SRMG English-language news publisher.

## Stack
- Drupal 7 (core 7.82), PHP, MySQL. Classic (non-Composer) Drupal layout.
- Standard Drupal entry points: `index.php`, `cron.php`, `authorize.php`, `update.php`, `install.php`.

## Layout
- `sites/` - site config, `settings.php`, and custom/contrib modules & themes (under `sites/all/` or `sites/default/`).
- `includes/`, `modules/`, `themes/` - Drupal 7 core (avoid editing core).
- Ads/verification files at root: `ads.txt`, `app-ads.txt`, `BingSiteAuth.xml`.

## Working notes
- This is legacy Drupal 7 - put customizations in custom modules/themes under `sites/all/`, never hack core.
- `settings.php` holds DB credentials and is environment-specific - never commit real credentials.
- Clear caches after config/code changes (`drush cc all` or admin > performance) if drush is available.
